title: AccreditationAlertRaisedPayload
description: An alert was raised with a re-accreditation assessment task (INV-REQ-1365). Carries no invoice content. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

taskRef.description: The re-accreditation assessment task opened with the alert.

releaseRef.description: The release train concerned, when there is one.

currentUntil.description: The last day the recorded accreditation is current.
